rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides access to 13 US federal government data domains across 11 agencies through the Open Primitive Protocol. All responses include cryptographic signatures (Ed25519) for data provenance verification, along with freshness guarantees, confidence scores, and citations. The protocol defines a standardized data envelope for agent-consumable government data.
